name: Pipeliners - Local SEO AEO AIO Plan 2026-10-10
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-10-10

# Summary
A single priority plan for ranking Pipeliners in the map pack, organic local results and AI answers (AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT). Built from Kim's lesson material plus 2026 research (Google Search Central AI guide, Whitespark 2026 factors, BrightLocal AI directory study) and the Pipeliners Master Profile. Core conclusion: map pack, AI Overviews and ChatGPT lean on the same inputs, so it is one plan, not three.

# Key findings
- Google Business Profile is the top source AI tools cite for local businesses (per the file, 54% of citations for plumbers).
- Where Pipeliners stood: 4.99 average Google rating with about 123 to 127 reviews, all replied to; GBP is the #1 lead source (23 of 63 leads in 30 days) but GBP website clicks were down 58% while views were flat; "trenchless sewer repair mesa" #2 in the map pack; AI visibility 44/100 (strong on ePIPE, 0 to 20 on commercial trenchless, 0 in AI Mode).
- Wrong phone numbers on listings: (480) 969-7978 on Birdeye and the Ace DuraFlo installer list, (480) 269-1874 in the brand AI Overview.

# Plan in priority order
- A. Reviews: steady asks by text after every job, personal replies. Google's April 2026 policy bans keyword requests, staff quotas, gating and incentives, so those lesson tactics are out.
- B. GBP (report only, read-only for Claude): confirm primary category, list every service, accurate hours, fresh photos. Do not stuff keywords into the business name.
- C. Listings cleanup (owner logins needed): claim Birdeye, fix the 969-7978 number, find the 269-1874 source, complete Yelp, BBB, Angi, Facebook, Apple Business Connect, Bing Places. Call-tracking numbers stay as they are.
- D. Website: one deep page per service (/services/ is thin; /epipe-restoration/ is an ad page, hands off), real local detail on city pages, link same-city service pages together, monthly GSC position 10 to 20 routine.
- E. AEO: keep question H2 plus 40 to 60 word answer format; fill commercial trenchless and slab leak gaps. FAQ rich results ended in May 2026.
- F. AI off-site mentions: local "best of" lists, local press, Mesa Chamber, manufacturer installer lists, genuine disclosed Reddit answers only.
- G. Not to do: bought citations, PBNs, fake addresses, schema or llms.txt as an "AI boost", chunking pages for AI.

# Measurement
Monthly map-pack checks, GSC Domain property clicks per page, LLMV recheck in late October against the 44/100 baseline, and leads by source in Keystone (next Oct 29).

# Decisions and status
- Several figures are marked not verified in the file (Whitespark weights, April 2026 review policy text, FAQ deprecation dates).
